records.name: Sunburst Canticle
records.meaning: Heal allies within 10 yards and deal Holy damage to enemies in the same area.
records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square fantasy MMO ability icon, legible at 24 pixels in color and grayscale.
Primary request: Sunburst Canticle heals nearby allies and damages nearby enemies simultaneously. Paint a large luminous ivory sun disc emitting eight broad alternating gold rays outward in a symmetric radial burst. A clearly separated dark circular ring around the disc emphasizes an expanding area. The disc and rays fill the square, with bold simple high-contrast shapes.
Style: original textured painterly dark-fantasy game art, ivory and gold light against deep navy, restrained detail, opaque full-bleed background.
Constraints: no hands, hearts, shields, figures, faces, lanterns, text, letters, borders, logos or watermark. No image inputs or copyrighted visual references.

Constraints: no skull, wings, human, weapons, text, letters, borders, logos or watermark. No image inputs or copyrighted visual references.
